errors.text_span: представено като хоризонтална стълбова диаграма с три цветни сегмента
errors.evidence: The description states that each statement is represented as a horizontal bar chart with three colored segments. This implies a stacked bar chart. However, the figure shows a grouped bar chart, where each statement has three separate, side-by-side bars, not segments within a single bar.

The description claims that the horizontal axis has intervals of 10 units. The figure does not show a horizontal axis line with tick marks or interval labels. The values are given as data labels on the bars themselves, so this detail about the axis intervals is fabricated.
This part of the description repeats the structural error of calling the bars 'segments'. The figure shows separate bars, not segments of a larger bar.
